original.target_description: Study 3: restaurant Studio 97 versus Studio 17; Cornell undergraduates; main effect of number in the 2 × 3 ANOVA of log-transformed willingness to pay. Locator p. 7 corresponds to printed p. 247. No subgroup is specified, so the main effect is selected.

n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this study; the six-cell ANOVA residual df is 188.
n.quote: One hundred ninety-four Cornell University undergraduates completed the study

es.quote: The main effect of number was significant, F(1, 188) ¼ 4.91, p ¼ .03

replication.target_description: Study 2: Restaurant item, Studio 97 versus Studio 17, independent-samples comparison of estimated restaurant bill after outlier exclusions.

n.sample_role: participants by anchor group (high; low); printed per-group analytic n
n.exclusions: Same outlier rule as Study 1; 7.37% of observations excluded across all items; two ambiguous estimates treated as missing. Restaurant row n is item-specific after exclusions.

p.location: p. 6, Table 2 Restaurant row; Study 2 Results; no numerical p printed for this test (table reports t, df and BF).

reported_success.quote: Participants did not estimate that a meal at Studio 97 would be more expensive than one at Studio 17

notes: Matching uses only supplied study/outcome/locator. Indistinguishable repeated locators are extracted identically; no item or subgroup is inferred from audit ID or input order. Printed group ns retained separately, without computing a total.
